title: Start-Day Timing Rate for Ridgeline Installation Services Start-of-Work Payments
content:
The day on which a Ridgeline Installation Services customer pays at the start of work, counted from the visit at which work started, sets a start-day timing rate.

**Clause.** Start-day timing rate of the start-of-work payment: the payment lag is the calendar days from the date of the installation visit at which work started to today; a payment lag of 0 days takes the start-day rate of -1 percent, a payment lag of more than the late-start-payment days of 7 takes the late-start-payment rate of 1.5 percent, and any other payment lag takes a rate of 0; a negative adjustment lowers the payment.

The start-day timing adjustment is the timing rate applied to the progress share after that share has been rounded to the cent, and the adjustment is itself rounded to the cent. It is added to the start-of-work payment.

## Terms used

- **The installation visit at which work started** is the most recent installation visit recorded on the contract with the outcome completed as scheduled.
- **The progress share** is taken exactly as it stands once it has been rounded to the cent; the timing rate is never applied to an amount before that rounding.

| Payment lag | Timing rate |
|---|---|
| 0 days (paid on the day work started) | -1 percent |
| 1 to 7 days | 0 |
| 8 days or more | 1.5 percent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical progress share 3000.00, work started 14 April)

| Paid on | Payment lag | Rate | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 April | 0 | -1 percent | -30.00, lowering the payment by 30.00 |
| 21 April | 7 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 22 April | 8 | 1.5 percent | 45.00 |
